key_finding: Only one residue is named: 'in CANSDC a key acidic residue that interacts with the distal amino group of other substrates is replaced by Leu(314)'. Broader specificity is attributed to a 'specificity helix' that distinguishes arginine from carboxynorspermidine decarboxylases, not one carboxypolyamine from another. Structures are PRODUCT complexes (agmatine, norspermidine).
context: C. jejuni 81116 CANSDC (PDB 3N29, 1.9 A); V. vulnificus ADC (3N2O, 2.3 A)
confidence_and_limits: High for what is claimed; does not address discrimination among carboxyspermidine / carboxynorspermidine / carboxyaminopropylagmatine

key_finding: The C. jejuni 'carboxynorspermidine decarboxylase' orthologue makes spermidine, not sym-norspermidine, in vivo. The alternative route is dominant in the human gut microbiome.
context: Campylobacter jejuni deletion strains; human gut/stomach/oral metagenomes
confidence_and_limits: High; shows the protein crystallised with norspermidine bound has a different native product, so 3N29's ligand is non-native

evidence_type: direct assay (steady-state and transient kinetics, MS, X-ray, SAXS)
claim_tested: Which amine initiates the ASA-dependent pathway in C. leptum
key_finding: The C. leptum and B. fragilis ASA-dependent dehydrogenases are carboxyaminopropylagmatine dehydrogenases, with dramatically enhanced catalytic efficiency on agmatine and 34-fold enhancement of NADPH affinity by agmatine versus a modest effect for putrescine.
context: Purified recombinant C. leptum and B. fragilis dehydrogenases
confidence_and_limits: High for the partner enzyme; the decarboxylase itself was not assayed, so the constraint on CLOLEP_01503 is pathway-level

claim_tested: Can the C. leptum structure define a substrate pocket
key_finding: Homodimer, two domains, PLP-binding beta/alpha barrel. Candidate selectivity regions are the beta6/beta7 flap and the alpha9/beta12 loop connected to the alpha9 helix 'which is thought to select substrates by their chain length'. No substrate or product is bound.
confidence_and_limits: High for the structure; the selectivity statement is explicitly a belief, not a measurement

claim_tested: What is required to make carboxynorspermidine
key_finding: The V. cholerae route needs a fused L-2,4-diaminobutyrate aminotransferase/decarboxylase to supply 1,3-diaminopropane; CANSDC deletion accumulates carboxynorspermidine.
confidence_and_limits: High; defines the gene family whose absence excludes the carboxynorspermidine route

evidence_type: mutant phenotype (gene deletion, HPLC, enzyme assay)
claim_tested: Substrate assignment in a Bacteroides homolog
key_finding: casdc deletion in B. thetaiotaomicron depletes spermidine and abolishes decarboxylase activity; complementation restores both.
confidence_and_limits: High; this enzyme carries Ser at the one variable pocket position yet is assigned carboxyspermidine, breaking any Glu/Ser specificity rule

claim_tested: Why speD/speE sit in the same cluster as the ASA pair
key_finding: Hybrid dcAdoMet + ASA pathways exist; in them spermidine is made from agmatine mainly by the ASA route, and both branches produce N1-aminopropylagmatine.
confidence_and_limits: Moderate-high; explains the C. leptum cluster composition but is not specific to CLOLEP_01503

key_finding: CASDH and CASDC mutants require exogenous spermidine or norspermidine for growth.
confidence_and_limits: Moderate; in vivo requirement, no substrate discrimination

claim_tested: Where specificity sits in group IV decarboxylases generally
key_finding: Specificity in the ODC/ADC branch maps to a 3(10)-helix in the active site; reorientation enlarges the pocket to accept L-lysine.
context: Vibrio vulnificus L/ODC, 1.7 and 2.15 A product complexes
confidence_and_limits: Moderate; establishes the precedent but for amino-acid substrates, not carboxypolyamines

evidence_type: computational (structure superposition, ligand audit, proteome inventory)
key_finding: No family PDB entry holds a carboxypolyamine; 9EAF holds PLP-Lys43 plus a His-tag octapeptide in the polyamine channel. 3N29->9EAF superposition 0.67 A over 337 CA places the nine polyamine contacts at K43, C173, E174, E240, D276, L307', Y335, K339, F343'. Eight of nine are invariant across seven homologs; the ninth (Glu/Ser) splits by phylum, not substrate. The genome has speA, speB-family, asd, speD, speE, CLOLEP_01502 and CLOLEP_01503 but no diaminobutyrate aminotransferase/decarboxylase and no ornithine decarboxylase.
confidence_and_limits: Computational only; proteome annotations are automatic, so absence of a gene family is evidence of absent annotation as well as absent gene
